verdict.rationale: Docusign's own docs show it can require stronger signer verification: phone one-time passcodes, government ID upload with a biometric challenge, risk-based verification that adjusts the required check, and '5 identity verifications' on eSignature plans. Knowledge-based authentication, one of the three named methods, is not evidenced, so coverage of the story is incomplete. missing for 10: knowledge-based authentication evidence, documentation of applying verification requirements per sensitive document or envelope, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, I can require stronger signer identity verification (SMS, ID check, knowledge-based) on sensitive documents

citations.quote: Require recipients to upload a photo of their government ID & complete a quick biometric challenge.
Enable repeat users to verify their identity by entering a one-time-passcode sent to their phone in seconds.
Dynamically adjust the type of verification your signers must complete based on an automated and instant risk assessment with our Risk-Based Verification workflow
Reduce fraud risk with 5 identity verifications
Check the authenticity of government issue identity documents or verify recipient identities in less than a minute.
